刚点启动，正在初始化（装依赖、编译、起服务）。健康检查会持续复查，就绪后自动转运: Initializing: installing dependencies, compiling, or starting services. Health checks continue until the app is ready.
进程活着，健康检查通过，URL 可正常访问。: The process is running and health checks pass. Its URL is accessible.
进程活着，但健康检查暂未通过。常见原因：服务还在编译、刚起来还没就绪、或 /he: The process is alive but has not passed health checks. It may still be compiling or starting, or have no /health endpoint. Rechecked every 5 seconds until healthy.
正在优雅停止（Ctrl-Break → 等待 → 强制回收进程树）。: Stopping gracefully: Ctrl-Break, wait, then terminate the process tree if needed.
进程异常退出（崩溃/报错）。看日志排查。: The process exited unexpectedly. Check its logs for details.
用浏览器打开发现的 URL: Open the detected URL in your browser
一个项目内可能有前端、后端、数据库多个服务，各自监听不同端口。平台会自动发现它们: A project may have frontend, backend, and database services on different ports. Each detected port shows its own health status. Click a port to open the service.
判断\"这个端口属于哪个项目\"用两条证据：① 端口的进程在本项目的进程树内（强: A port belongs to a project when its process is in the project's process tree, or its URL appears in the project's logs. Ports without either link are excluded to keep projects separate.
启动项目时，若检测到该项目历史用过的端口被残留进程占用，会自动杀掉占用进程，然后: Before starting a project, RunDock terminates leftover processes occupying its previously used ports to prevent EADDRINUSE conflicts.
日志证据必须叠加时间窗：端口必须是\"本项目启动之后\"才开始监听的。启动前就存: Log-based detection only includes ports that started listening after the project started. Existing unrelated ports are excluded.
项目整体状态由所有服务综合判定：全部健康 = 运行中；任一不健康 = 降级；全挂: All services healthy: running. Any unhealthy service: degraded. All failed: failed. A service problem is reflected in the project status.
降级状态的服务每 5 秒复查一次，恢复就转运行中并停止复查。运行中的服务不再复查: Degraded services are checked every 5 seconds until healthy. Checks stop after recovery. Requests stay on 127.0.0.1; they do not access external networks.

退出将停止所有正在运行的项目服务并关闭程序。: Quitting stops all running project services and closes the application.
